description: REPLACE the list of origins allowed to render this project's forms with a publishable key. The list is not merged: anything you leave out stops being allowed, so a live embed can go dark. Read the current list with fillo_get_origins, pass confirm=true when the user authorized this replacement list. Otherwise ask for their decision. An empty array means any origin. Entries must be bare http(s) origins with no path. Needs workspace:manage.

confirm.description: Set true when the user has authorized this action on the specified target in the task or workflow. Ask only if that authorization is missing.

origins.description: The complete new list, e.g. ["https://app.example.com"]. [] means any origin.

name: fillo_set_origins
title: Set the allowed embed origins
